programmes.d: The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.
A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.
A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.
The fastest gun (George Montgomery) in Texas is let out of prison to help the Rangers stop a gang of outlaws.
Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.
A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.
A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).
A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.
Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.
A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.
A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.
